test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following sentences uses the word "bow" with the **same meaning** as in the following sentence?

"The performer took a deep bow to thank the audience"

options.text: She carefully tied the ribbon into a perfect bow.
He used the strong fishing line to make a tight bow.
The small gift was decorated with a large red bow.
The children were taught to bow to the queen as a sign of respect.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bow"** is a homonym, meaning it has multiple meanings depending on context. In this sentence, it refers to bending the upper part of the body forward as a gesture of respect, acknowledgment, or greeting. (झुकना)

 
 
• **Example: **The performer took a deep bow to thank the audience for their applause.
 

 
• The correct sentence from the options that uses the word "bow" with the same meaning is: Option 4 - "The children were taught to bow to the queen as a sign of respect." Here, "bow" means to bend forward as an act of respect. (झुकना)

 
 
• **Example: **The children bowed gracefully to greet the queen.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "She carefully tied the ribbon into a perfect bow."** 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Here, "bow" refers to a decorative knot, often made with loops. (फंदा या सजावटी गांठ)
 
• **Example:** The bow on the gift box made it look even more beautiful.
 
 

 
• **Option 2: "He used the strong fishing line to make a tight bow."** 
 
 
• **Meaning:** In this context, "bow" refers to a curved shape or an arch, such as in a bow used for archery. (धनुष)
 
• **Example:** The archer pulled the string of the bow tightly before releasing the arrow.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: "The small gift was decorated with a large red bow."** 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Similar to Option 1, "bow" here refers to a decorative knot. (फंदा या सजावटी गांठ)
 
• **Example:** She spent hours making the perfect bow for the present.
 
 

39:T69d,

The correct answer is **option 1.**
